name: Gasthof Goldene Krone
beschreibung: The Gasthof Goldene Krone is situated in a charming village in the Tyrolean Inntal valley. The property harmoniously combines traditional alpine timber craftsmanship with modern guest accommodation. Guests can look forward to a peaceful ambience and genuine regional hospitality. The surroundings are characterised by imposing mountains, lush forests, and extensive hiking paths. The on-site restaurant serves seasonal dishes prepared with local ingredients. Guest rooms are practically appointed and feature either a private balcony or a terrace.
